profile.headline: Owner at Be More
profile.summary:
Primarily UI Design and clean, semantic, accessible design. With a strong background in many programming languages and additional benefit of creativity, UI presentation has become an outlet for these skills. With aspirations to join a group of talented people working on advanced projects.

Specialties: UI Design and content presentation with focus on (x)HTML, CSS, JavaScript libraries and Flash development.

positions.title: Owner / Web Developer
positions.description: Doing freelance and contract work for companies nationwide from WordPress CMS sites, custom site development and interface design, social media widgets, mobile sites, e-commerce solutions, e-newsletters, print design, and more...

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
An apparel brand focused on spread happiness,love and positivity
https://bemorebrand.com

positions.title: Owner / Partner
positions.description: Providing standalone solutions and custom products for transplanting Duramax engines into your project vehicle.

positions.title: Partner / Lead Developer
positions.description: Providing website solutions to 3 of the top Advertising agencies and PR firms in Las Vegas as well as several companies nationwide. Primarily WordPress CMS solutions with custom themes.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
- Support and integration of advanced features and functionality provided for SEO & SEM clients.
- Provide consulting on implementation and solutions for client needs.
- Updates and feature enhancements to several CMS solutions including WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, Custom CMS and others.
- Plugin research and implementation for WordPress CMS solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Brought on to develop OJO Agent for mobile devices using LAMP, JavaScript, CSS3 and HTML5.

positions.title: Contractor (Senior Web Developer)
positions.description: Leading the site redesign charge by cut and coding designs, writing CSS, organizing site structure and writing jQuery for their upcoming website refresh.

positions.title: Lead Web Designer
positions.description: Implementation of designs responsible for IA, UI, JS, Design, Templating, Animation, HTML5, CSS3, XHTML, AJAX, JSON, XML, jQuery.

positions.title: Lead Project/Web Developer
positions.description:
- Design and implementation of a third-party community solution.
- Re-organization of CMS system and process by content editors
- Creation of a stronger brand, new website with web 2.0 technology and proper acknowledgement of semantics and web standards, with a focus on accessibility.

Technologies: XHTML, XML, CSS2, Flash, AS3, JQuery, Sitecore, Adobe Design Products

positions.title: Application/Flash Developer
positions.description:
- Front-end design, styling, page construction, user interface and web 2.0 functionality.
- Position evolved into professional Flash development.
- Achieved 4 production ready custom FLV players in AS2 and AS3, plus site modules.
- Construction of internal, online project lifecycle tool, providing an organizational tool for assignment of projects, due dates, outline details from concept to QA walkthrough.

Technologies: PHP, Flash, AS2, AS3, JavaScript, CSS2, XHTML, XML, AJAX, SVN, Unix, MySQL, Adobe Design Products

positions.title: Senior Web Designer
positions.description:
- Design, presentation and construction of the New York - New York website.
- Banner creation and bug site fixes for all properties.
- E-mail campaign construction and testing. E-mail specs for multi-client requirements.
- Presentation and colaboration with directors and project management.

Technologies: HTML, CSS2, JavaScript, Adobe Design Products, VSS, Flash, integration of .NET reservations system
